strings.settings.startupApproval: On the Mac running this app, allow MediaDownloader in System Settings → General → Login Items & Extensions, then refresh the status here.
strings.search.title: Search
strings.search.subtitle: Find torrents across all configured sources
strings.search.emptyPrompt: Type a query above to start searching
strings.search.noResultsHint: Try different keywords or another source.
strings.search.outcomeFailedDetail: This source could not be reached ({0}). Its results are missing from the list below.

strings.downloads.title: Downloads
strings.downloads.subtitle: Active transfers and completed items
strings.downloads.emptyHint: Search for torrents or set up a series task and downloads will show up here.

strings.downloads.noAuto: No automatic downloads yet — Series Tasks download new episodes here automatically.

strings.downloads.deleteMessage: Delete "{0}"? Choose whether to also delete the downloaded files.
strings.series.title: Series Tasks
strings.series.subtitle: Each task periodically checks for the next episode and downloads it automatically. Changes save automatically.
strings.series.emptyHint: Create one and new episodes will download themselves.
strings.series.name: Name
strings.series.queryHelp: e.g. 'One Piece 1080p' — sent to the torrent site
strings.series.folderHelp: Leave empty to use the default folder from Settings
strings.series.noDownloads: Nothing downloaded for this series yet.
strings.series.deleteConfirm: Delete "{0}"? This won't cancel or delete any of its downloads — they'll show up as manual downloads instead.
strings.series.deleteConfirmWithDownloads: Delete "{0}"? It has {1} download(s), which won't be cancelled or deleted — they'll show up as manual downloads instead.
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.subtitle: All changes are saved automatically
strings.settings.stopSeedingHelp: Completed torrents stop immediately and no longer upload.
strings.settings.keepSeedingHelp: Completed torrents keep seeding to other peers until you pause or remove them.
strings.settings.sourcesHint: Turn a source off to exclude it from searches — useful for sources that return junk or dead torrents.
strings.settings.agentHint: Let AI agents and scripts search, manage downloads, and control series tasks through MCP or REST.
strings.settings.agentLoopbackHint: Requests from this computer need no token. Browser cross-origin requests are always blocked.
strings.settings.agentRemoteHint: Remote requests are limited to agent endpoints and require HTTPS plus the bearer token. Put a TLS reverse proxy on this computer in front of the local URL.
strings.settings.agentRegenerateConfirm: Existing remote clients will stop working until they are updated. Generate a new agent access token?
strings.settings.agentRestart: Remote authorization changed. Restart MediaDownloader after changing its HTTPS listener or TLS proxy configuration.
strings.settings.agentRegenerated: A new agent access token was generated. Existing remote clients must be updated.
strings.settings.desktopHint: Shown through the browser. Allow notifications for this site when the browser asks.
strings.settings.topicHint: Subscribe to this topic in the ntfy app to receive pushes on your phone
strings.settings.botTokenHint: Create a bot with @BotFather to get a token
strings.settings.chatIdHint: Your chat id — message @userinfobot to find it, then send /start to your bot
strings.settings.testSent: Test notification dispatched to all enabled channels
strings.settings.installNote: Installing update — the app will restart, reload this page in a moment…
strings.dialog.folderHelp: The torrent's files will be saved here
strings.folderBrowser.notExistYet: Folder does not exist yet — it will be created when the download starts.
strings.settings.errorReportsHint: Crash details with titles, paths, addresses and tokens removed, to help fix bugs. Never your searches or downloads.
strings.connection.reconnecting: The app is not responding — reconnecting…
strings.remote.deviceOffline: This device is offline. It reconnects on its own when it is back online.
strings.remote.title: Remote access
strings.remote.hint: Manage this device from anywhere at mediadownloader.codefusion.cc. Everything is end-to-end encrypted: the website only relays data it cannot read.
strings.remote.waiting: Waiting for you to approve in the browser tab that opened…
strings.remote.browsers: Browsers that can reach this device
strings.remote.linkBrowser: Link a phone or another browser
strings.remote.linkHint: Scan this code with your phone, or open the link in another browser signed in to the same account.
strings.remote.linkWarning: The link carries this browser’s key. Only open it on your own devices.
strings.remote.disconnectConfirm: It will disappear from your account and every linked browser loses access. You can connect it again later.
strings.remote.revokeConfirm: It will no longer be able to reach this device, even when signed in.
strings.import.title: Import from the previous version
strings.import.hint: Found a MediaDownloader 1.x database with {0} downloads and {1} series tasks. Import them, with your settings, into this version.
strings.import.alreadyImported: Already imported. Importing again only adds what is missing.
strings.cloud.e2eNote: Searches, downloads and settings travel end-to-end encrypted between this browser and your device. This website cannot read them.
strings.pair.title: Connect a device
strings.pair.question: Connect this device to {0}?
strings.pair.noKey: This link was opened without its key, so this browser won’t be linked. Link it later from the device’s dashboard.
strings.pair.expired: This pairing link has expired. Start again from the device’s Settings.
strings.pair.alreadyApproved: This device has already been connected.
strings.link.title: Linking this browser…
strings.link.invalid: This link is incomplete. Create a new one from the device’s Settings → Remote access.
strings.link.otherAccount: That device belongs to a different account. Sign in with the account it is connected to.
strings.devices.title: Your devices
strings.devices.subtitle: Computers running MediaDownloader connected to your account.
strings.devices.emptyHint: On the computer running MediaDownloader, open Settings → Remote access and choose “Connect to your account”.
strings.devices.removeConfirm: Remove “{0}” from your account? Every linked browser loses access.
strings.devices.notLinkedTitle: This browser isn’t linked to the device
strings.devices.notLinkedHint: Only linked browsers hold the key to talk to a device. On the device’s dashboard (or a linked browser) open Settings → Remote access → Link a phone or another browser, and scan the QR code.
